title.en: A weekly fix list for a small SaaS team
title.zh: 为小型 SaaS 团队整理每周产品改进

body.en: The public B2B SaaS activation sample turns support tickets, session notes, and churn reasons into weekly product fixes. Its audience is seed-stage founders, product managers, and customer success leads without a growth analyst.
body.zh: 公开的 B2B SaaS 激活样例，把支持工单、使用记录与流失原因整理为每周产品改进。对象是没有专职增长分析师的种子期创始人、产品经理与客户成功负责人。

detail.en: Constraint: two people, no data warehouse; the first demo must work with uploaded CSVs and copied support notes.
detail.zh: 约束：两人团队、没有数据仓库；首次演示需要能使用上传的 CSV 与复制的支持记录。

title.en: An assumption with two traceable records
title.zh: 给假设附上两条可追溯记录

body.en: The seeded example marks the first experiment as supported with high confidence. Its two evidence records keep stable IDs, so a decision can point back to the exact observation.
body.zh: 预置样例将第一个实验标为「得到支持」，置信度为高。两条证据保留稳定 ID，便于决策回到具体观察。

detail.en: These are fictional records seeded in the public demo, not findings from a real customer study.
detail.zh: 这些是公开产品演示中的预置虚构记录，不是真实客户研究结果。

title.en: Keep the useful workflow; defer the prediction
title.zh: 保留改进建议，暂缓预测功能

body.en: The example's recorded decision keeps weekly activation-fix recommendations in the MVP and defers predictive churn scoring. It narrows the product scope to what the seeded observations support.
body.zh: 样例记录的决策是：在 MVP 中保留每周激活改进建议，暂缓预测性流失评分。产品范围落在预置观察能够支持的部分。

detail.en: In the product, decision claims cite recorded evidence IDs. Changing the evidence makes an old decision brief stale and requires review.
detail.zh: 真实产品中的决策主张需要引用已记录的证据 ID。证据变化后，旧决策摘要会失效，需要重新审阅。

body.en: The sample's next action is to test whether founders will upload support notes before connecting a help-desk integration. The decision becomes a follow-up experiment instead of the end of a chat.
body.zh: 样例的下一步是：在连接帮助台集成之前，测试创始人是否愿意上传支持记录。决策继续转化为实验，而不是停在一段回答。

detail.en: You can inspect the seeded data or open the public product to explore the full workflow.
detail.zh: 可以查看预置数据的源码，或打开公开产品体验完整流程。

text.en: 4 of 5 founders preferred a weekly prioritized fix list over another analytics dashboard.
text.zh: 5 位创始人中的 4 位更倾向每周优先改进清单，而非另一个分析看板。

text.en: 3 founders identified an onboarding change within ten minutes.
text.zh: 3 位创始人在十分钟内找到了一个入门流程改进点。
